name: Veer Narayan Singh
role: Early anti-colonial rebel in central India
contribution: Veer Narayan Singh led an early anti-colonial and agrarian resistance in Sonakhan, and was executed in 1857 after defying Company authority.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His story connects food scarcity, local leadership, and anti-colonial resistance in central India before and during 1857.
highlight: Veer Narayan Singh was an early anti-colonial rebel leader in central India and a prominent figure of 1857 memory.
seoTitle: Veer Narayan Singh: Early Resistance before 1857
seoDescription: Learn about Veer Narayan Singh's agrarian resistance in Sonakhan and his execution during the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Veer Narayan Singh was a central Indian rebel leader who organized resistance to Company authority and was executed in 1857.
